audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers gave Cho'Gath levels 3, 4-5 and first item, and gave Mordekaiser level 1. That contradicts the packet chart (Skill, then Mordekaiser through first item, Cho'Gath at 2+ items) and it contradicts this matchup's own prose, which says levels 1-3 are his, 4-6 stay in his hands, and his first item out-sustains you.
audit.why: Mordekaiser has no mana, an 8s Obliterate that pays a bonus for hitting you isolated, a shield on 12s, and a 700-range pull. Cho'Gath's only lane teeth pre-Feast is a 950-range Rupture he has to walk up to land. Nothing about levels 3-5 belongs to Cho'Gath.
audit.corrected: Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Cho'Gath, proposed as one atomic chart group across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side+rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named Heartsteel as the moment to 'force fights' at first item, and the breakdown listed Cho'Gath spikes at levels 2-3. Both are inverted: his first item is the low point of the lane for you.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s and steals stats; Cho'Gath's real spike is Feast stacks plus an MR item, which is a two-item timing, not a first-item one.
audit.corrected: Cho'Gath spikes moved to Feast stacks + first MR piece (Force of Nature / Spirit Visage) at two items; Mordekaiser spikes at 2, at 6, and at first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive P/Q/W/E/R interaction was never stated. Text said only 'Q-zone him in it' and 'W-silence his combo' without naming what is silenced or what the knockup denies.
audit.why: The interaction that decides the lane is Death's Grasp (E, 16s at rank 1) pulling you into an isolated Obliterate. Rupture knocks him up out of the follow-up and Feral Scream (9-11s) silences the Obliterate. Feast is true damage, so Mordekaiser's MR and his stolen resistances do nothing against it — that is why the 2-item duel flips.
audit.corrected: Stated explicitly in tradeGood, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why and the Key Ability Interactions report row, with the real cooldown numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization told you to buy Thornmail and 'anti-heal early' against Mordekaiser.
audit.why: Mordekaiser deals magic damage; armour and Thornmail's on-hit-to-attacker mechanic are close to dead weight. The matchup's own late-game text already says Bramble Vest does nothing here, so the two lines contradicted each other.
audit.corrected: Heartsteel then Riftmaker, Mercury's Treads, and MR (Force of Nature / Spirit Visage) instead of armour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect flagged: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0.
audit.why: Every commit decision in this lane keys off two numbers the player can count: Death's Grasp at 16s rank 1 and Realm of Death at 140s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now drive breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and the ahead text.

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both of you are combo-reliant at 1 — start Q, farm with Vorpal Spikes, and read how he contests the first wave before committing to anything.

edits.before: W silence starts flipping his combo windows. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Obliterate hits harder on an isolated target and his shield is up — eat one auto for the wave, leave pull range.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Death's Grasp (16s at rank 1) into an isolated Obliterate beats any extended fight your slow Rupture starts — do not step up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Pre-item Mordekaiser under Indestructible beats your pre-Feast body in a sustained trade — freeze, farm Carnivore sustain, and stack.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Realm of Death (140s at rank 1) drags you into a walled 1v1 and steals your stats while you have no Feast stacks and no MR — refuse the level-6 all-in.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Realm of Death's cooldown.
edits.after: His Riftmaker out-sustains your half-built MR — keep farming Feast stacks instead of contesting.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Feast stacks plus Force of Nature or Spirit Visage flip it — your R's true damage ignores his MR and wins the realm 1v1 outright.

edits.before: Build MR and silence his realm combo. Track Realm of Death before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Survive to two items: build MR, stack Feast, and win the realm 1v1 with a true-damage R that his MR cannot reduce.

edits.before: Mordekaiser wins by landing Realm of Death, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Mordekaiser wins on Death's Grasp into an isolated Obliterate, then Realm of Death before your Feast stacks.

edits.before: Q under Mordekaiser's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Rupture him as Death's Grasp lands, Feral Scream the Obliterate follow-up, then walk out — knockup plus silence eats his whole combo.

edits.before: Whiffing Q and fighting anyway — without the knockup your kit is a slow zone with no teeth.
edits.after: Stepping into Death's Grasp range to land Rupture — he pulls, isolates the Q, and you lose it.

edits.before: Q under Mordekaiser's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Force of Nature or Spirit Visage, never armour — his whole kit is magic damage, so Thornmail buys you almost nothing here.

edits.before: His 1v1 realm. Q-zone him in it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 140s at rank 1. Bait it, survive it, then own the next two minutes.

edits.before: Mordekaiser wastes Realm of Death — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Feral Scream (9s at rank 5) cancels the Obliterate follow-up after his pull.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm. Q-zone him in it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Realm of Death: 140/120/100s — bait it and the next two minutes of lane are yours. - Death's Grasp: 16s at rank 1, his only pull; step up while it is spent. - Feral Scream: 11s at rank 1, saved for his Obliterate.

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Respect Mordekaiser's Realm of Death completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Last-hit with Vorpal Spikes at max range and let Carnivore top you off. Death's Grasp on 16s is the cooldown that decides whether you can step up — not his ultimate, which does not exist until 6.

edits.before: Track Mordekaiser's Realm of Death: His 1v1 realm. Q-zone him in it. When it is down — Q-W + R him.
edits.after: Rupture knocks up out of his pull follow-up, Feral Scream silences Obliterate, Feast true damage beats MR.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel  (stacks with Feast forever), then Riftmaker / Thornmail; boots Mercury's Treads. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel (stacks with Feast forever), then Riftmaker; boots Mercury's Treads. Build MR — Force of Nature or Spirit Visage — never armour, because every point of his damage is magic.

edits.before: Lead banked — now convert. Shove, take plates, recall on your Heartsteel timing, then freeze and zone Mordekaiser off the comeback farm. Dive with your jungler when Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Lead banked — now convert. Shove, take plates, recall on your Heartsteel timing, then freeze and zone Mordekaiser off the comeback farm. Dive with your jungler in the two minutes after his ult is spent.

notes: Cho'Gath kit file flags Rupture (Q) as 'grounding'. Riot's own description says it pops enemies into the air, i.e. a knockup — I wrote it as a knockup throughout and did not claim any grounding effect. Mordekaiser's Obliterate carries the same suspect 'grounding' flag and I ignored it too. Realm of Death's interaction with cleanse/QSS/Zhonya's is not in the kit data and I did not assert anything about it.
